rationale: EO 11816 (October 23, 1974) restated section 301(a) of Part III of EO 10973, as amended, delegating certain Foreign Assistance Act reporting functions (section 514(a)(2) and (b), the second sentence of section 612(a), and section 634(f) and (g)) to the Secretary of the Treasury. Under the strike-and-insert ruling an amendment continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 12163 of September 29, 1979, Sec. 1-903(a)(1), revoked Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended, and its Sec. 1-905 makes the order effective as of October 1, 1979. The status is NO: the parent order was revoked effective October 1, 1979.
